meta.title: DSH Git
meta.description: One clean git and GitHub surface: a single `git` tool for status, per-task worktrees, commit, push, sync, pull requests and merges, plus two automatic behaviours that remove the failure modes this profile kept hitting. A few seconds after a turn's edits stop, its changed files are committed and, when the branch is safe to push, pushed - so no work is left dirty or unsynced because a session forgot. A guard watches `bash` and redirects raw mutating git at the tool that does it consistently, denying the commands that discard work other sessions hold in a worktree. Worktrees live under <session workspace>/.worktrees/<repo>/<slug> on a dsh/<slug> branch, locked while a session owns them, and a worktree whose commits are not on the remote is kept rather than removed. How to use: ask the agent for the `git` tool, or type /git in the composer to print the working tree state. Auto-commit, auto-push, guard strictness, worktree location, branch prefix, protected branches and timeouts are all set by overriding this bundle's row in the profile's own patch layer.
